chosen: tonk pull + push after every recorded change
title: Sync the space at every turn
why: Keeps every agent's view fresh immediately.
name: decision-sync-every-turn

chosen: Inline diffs up to and including 64 KB; blob above
title: Blob threshold is 64 KB, inline below
why: Clarifies the boundary case at exactly 64 KB after review.
name: decision-blob-threshold-64k

chosen: flock-style lock on $DATA_ROOT/locks/<space>.lock around every tonk eval, with retry on exit 4
rejected: Write directly and let tonk's lock reject; retry blindly
title: Recorder takes its own lock around tonk writes
why: tonk's revision.lock rejects concurrent writers (exit 4, nothing committed); the recorder serialises itself first and fails open after 3 attempts.
name: decision-writer-lock

chosen: A diff over 64 KB goes through `tonk blob add` and the change references it as blob:<hash>
rejected: Always inline the diff in the change record
title: Store diffs larger than 64 KB as blobs
why: Keeps revisions small; the blob store dedupes large payloads and `tonk blob cat` reads them back.
name: decision-blob-diffs

chosen: Sync only at session start/end, every 10 turns, or on demand
title: Checkpoint sync instead of every turn
why: Concurrent eval --no-sync writers collide on the revision lock (contracts/cli-checks.md); checkpoint sync keeps a swarm from fighting over the shared head.
name: decision-checkpoint-sync
